plain_result: A universal per-student subsidy is pro-rich in this model (concentration index 0.406 vs -0.479 for means-testing) because enrolment rises with income; the investment arithmetic gives a positive NPV at 5% and an IRR of 25.0%. These are arithmetic consequences of the stated assumptions, not policy estimates.
